sara.dev: Quick handback — deploy for release/2026.03.17 finished, canary at 5% (prod). Handing off smoke checks and rollback readiness. Please report results here.

ops-bot: Deploy job ci-deploy/2109876543 succeeded -> prod (canary=5%). Logs: https://ci.internal/job/2109876543 :white_check_mark:

mike_release: I'll run the standard 3-step smoke: /health across regions, a quick inference, and an embeddings sanity run. Est ~5–10m.

nia_oncall: /health quick sweep done (us-west1, eu-west2, ap-south1) — all 200 OK.

nia_oncall: curl outputs:
```
$ curl -sS https://prod.api.redwood/v1/health
{"status":"ok","uptime_s":12345}
```

nia_oncall: latency snapshot: p50 120ms, p95 380ms, p99 820ms (eu-west2 tail a bit high). No 5xx spikes in last 5m.

lee_infra: Monitoring dashboards look clean. QPS steady (~420), error rate 0.02%. KV cache hit ratio 72% — within expected. Auto-scaler had 1 transient scale up, settled. :thumbsup:

jonathan: did a quick generate test (prompt: "Summarize recent infra change in 1 sentence") — returned 98 tokens, coherent. sample: "Adjusted autoscale thresholds to better absorb short bursts, avoiding needless restarts." No weird outputs.

samira_pm: Noting eu-west2 p99 is slightly above baseline. My tolerance: trigger rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m or p95 > 800ms sustained for 10m. Otherwise continue monitoring.

mike_release: embeddings check: 5/5 similarity samples within expected cosine ranges.

lee_infra: applied a non-disruptive tweak to GPU autoscale thresholds (min 2 -> min 2, target util 60% -> 70%) to reduce cold-starts. No restarts.

ops-bot: smoke-runner results: inference tests 10/10 pass; latency tests 4/4 pass; basic auth & routing checks ok.

mike_release: rollback readiness: reviewed. Staged rollback job exists: /deploy rollback release/2026.03.16 (requires manual confirm). Tag pinned: release/2026.03.16-pin.

sara.dev: Good. If no flags in 30m we'll promote canary -> 100% and close the rollout. I'll update the release ticket and leave this thread for any late flags.

samira_pm: I'll hold on monitoring for 45m and will ping if anything drifts.

sara.dev: Thanks all — handback complete unless anyone objects. :tada:
